target_customer: Corporate travel buyers and travel management companies, with employees booking through Slack, Teams or email
problem: Corporate travel booking is slow and agent dependent; employees want to book as easily as sending a chat message while staying within company policy.
business_model: B2B SaaS for companies and travel management companies

founders.name: Atyab Bhatti
previous_startups: earnJarvis (earlier name of SkyLink per one source)
founders.background_notes: Secondary profile says he had travel agent ideas from 2016; details unverified.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed GDS and NDC integrations with Amadeus, Sabre and Travelport, policy engines and a chat interface; before LLMs, conversational booking was harder.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and enterprise security certifications help, but the wedge of a chat front end over existing supply was copyable by larger travel platforms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Amadeus acquired SkyLink in Feb 2026 rather than building the capability; terms not disclosed.

market_need_then: Corporate travel managers and travelers disliked clunky booking tools and agent dependence in the post-2020 recovery; no specific dated spend figures were found in the sources reviewed.

identity.logo: Logo file exists for dark backgrounds; design not described in sources
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and brisk, e.g. '2 Clicks. 0 Wait.' and 'Built By Travelers, for Travelers'

branding.brand_signature: The 'book like sending a Slack message' positioning

rebrands.why: not stated; source is a single secondary listing

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with several unrelated SkyLink companies in travel retail and aviation; press about the brand itself was not found.

outcome_analysis: SkyLink built an AI chat based corporate travel booking agent, raised a seed of about $4M after YC in 2022, won travel management company partners such as BCD Travel in 2025 and enterprise customers, and was acquired by Amadeus in February 2026. The conversational AI wave made its wedge valuable to incumbents, who chose to buy rather than build; price is undisclosed.
notes: Seed amount comes from Seedtable and PhocusWire describing it as more than $4M; investors beyond YC not confirmed. CB Insights shows a $25M valuation in Apr 2022, unverified, not recorded. No competitor source dated near Jan 2022 was found; Navan and SAP Concur appear only on an AI generated profile, so the list is empty. Acquisition seen in many outlets including the Amadeus release dated 2026-02-24 per the YC page.
